Glostrup is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report benchmarks clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, focusing on key metrics such as Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant (AC) treatment [^src1]. 

In the report's municipal breakdown, Glostrup's specific data regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is detailed using calculations derived from the DanStroke registry [^src1]. This inclusion allows for local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system, positioning Glostrup alongside other municipalities in the national dataset [^src1]. Because the available corpus data consists solely of its statistical entry in this table, no further historical, relational, or descriptive details are available for the municipality in this context.
